supplemental_items.interpretation: Unpack A stop and physical Order match. Obtain canonical stop triple then S29; S30 only if before. Initialize behavior start=A-stop exact, decision null, use_pre false.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of ordered evaluation, mutation, provenance or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Pre candidate sets simple and red_source reference, trend ordinal zero. S31 returned time serves both behavior start and candidate gate; preliminary S37 scans from Order confirmation with fallback true. Null exits entire route; nonfallback sets use_pre, fallback clears decision only, not pre candidate.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of ordered evaluation, mutation, provenance or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: If not use_pre reset behavior start and call S16 again, set advanced flag. Advanced source is Order bottom source B/top R, price normalized full main extreme (not raw Order box edge), gate nested confirmation, red_source null.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of ordered evaluation, mutation, provenance or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Simple when not use_pre and no advanced. S15 null exits immediately, otherwise S17 last-equal source. red_source pre candidate if present else S24 call still happens, even though non-pre Red later ignores it. Preserve possible error/side effects, not dead-code elimination. Gate aligned trend confirmation.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of ordered evaluation, mutation, provenance or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Only absent decision invokes normal S37 with fallback default false. Null exits. Unpack, convert Order Break even for Blue. Red uses pre source only if use_pre and red_source nonnull, else S13 earliest equal inclusive Break..decision. Blue retains selected source.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of ordered evaluation, mutation, provenance or implicit dependency beyond original category labels.
